acquisition method: The most intense precursor ions (intensity ≥ 5.0 × 103) with charge states 3–8 and monoisotopic peak determination set to ‘peptide’ were selected for MS/MS fragmentation by CID at 35% collision energy in a data-dependent mode.
cleavage agent: In short, samples were dried (Eppendorf, Concentrator plus), resuspended in 8 M urea, reduced, alkylated and digested with trypsin (Promega).
collision energy: The most intense precursor ions (intensity ≥ 5.0 × 103) with charge states 3–8 and monoisotopic peak determination set to ‘peptide’ were selected for MS/MS fragmentation by CID at 35% collision energy in a data-dependent mode.
enrichment method: Crosslinked peptides were enriched by size exclusion chromatography (SEC) using an ÄKTAmicro chromatography system (GE Healthcare) equipped with a Superdex Peptide 3.2/30 column (column volume, 2.4 ml).
fractionation method: Crosslinked peptides were enriched by size exclusion chromatography (SEC) using an ÄKTAmicro chromatography system (GE Healthcare) equipped with a Superdex Peptide 3.2/30 column (column volume, 2.4 ml).
fragmentation method: The most intense precursor ions (intensity ≥ 5.0 × 103) with charge states 3–8 and monoisotopic peak determination set to ‘peptide’ were selected for MS/MS fragmentation by CID at 35% collision energy in a data-dependent mode.
instrument: LC–MS/MS analysis was carried out on an Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Electron).
labeling: LC–MS/MS analysis was carried out on an Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Electron).
